capabilities: Import broker CSV exports and FIFO-pair order rows into round-trip trades
Compute P&L metrics, win rate, expectancy and drawdown episodes per account
Visualize equity curves, daily P&L calendars and strategy/symbol/weekday breakdowns
Filter, bulk-tag and bulk-delete trades in a sortable trade log
Flag data-quality gaps such as missing stops, exits or written reviews
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states UI strings are Chinese only with no i18n yet, and lists deliberate exclusions (no R-multiple analytics, multi-currency or cloud sync).
motivation: The author wanted a journal where the trade log is plain Markdown with YAML frontmatter — portable, durable and queryable — with the analytics layer added on top as read-only views.
problem: Most trading journals keep trade data in a vendor's database, so traders cannot own, sync, edit or script over their own trade log.
summary: Local-first trading journal that stores each trade as a Markdown note and computes P&L dashboards, calendar heatmaps, equity curves and drawdown reviews.
